scientific_gates.G0: complete contract and independent Yee/control measurement certification only; never a DCO score
scientific_gates.G1: all registered sequential development H/E targets meet R and field/probe gates
scientific_gates.G2: main 1024 and repeat-seed 128 are required before a long-run claim
scientific_gates.G3: same main trajectory reaches 8192 with registered field/spectral gates

metrics.nMAE: ordinary masked MAE/reference maximum on declared component support
metrics.MRE_eq5_physical: strict-zero values use absolute error; nonzero values use relative error
metrics.rule: nMAE and MRE are separate columns and are never compared as the same quantity

prohibitions: Do not reset budget by recovery or resume old failed checkpoints.
Do not count exact Yee or geometry controls as DCO results.
Do not weaken gates after observing data.
Do not start 64/128/1024/8192 without the declared predecessor gate.
